sources.title: On Drawdown-Modulated Feedback Control in Stock Trading
sources.use: Related state/cushion feedback idea. Its idealized market has zero transaction costs, zero interest and known return support. Our exactfee, CPI and empirical support require our own conditional derivation; its guarantee is not inherited.

sources.title: Distributional Robust Kelly Gambling
sources.use: Related minimum expected log-growth over possible distributions. Our finite descriptive ensemble and paired trade/hold objective do not identify the true law or claim the continuous robust optimum.

sources.title: Risk-Constrained Kelly Gambling
sources.authors: Enzo Busseti; Ernest K. Ryu; Stephen Boyd
sources.use: Separates long-run growth from a probability constraint under a specified gambling law. Its drawdown from an initial level and distributional assumptions cannot be silently substituted for our real running-peak finite-horizon loss.

notes: Paraphrases and assumption checks from primary sources. Our construction/engineering is AI assisted and must be attributed; no claim of new drawdown-control literature.
